# email-mcp — Full Documentation
> Version 0.4.1 — FastMCP 3.4+ — 188 tests — 42 MCP tools

## Quick Start
```powershell
.\start.ps1
```
Requires Python 3.12+, uv. Opens web dashboard at http://localhost:10812.
`.env` is loaded automatically at server startup (repo root).

## Supported Email Systems
- **Microsoft Graph**: personal Outlook/Hotmail (SMTP/IMAP basic auth disabled) —
  OAuth device flow, public client ID, no Azure registration
- **SMTP/IMAP**: Gmail, Outlook/M365, Yahoo, iCloud, ProtonMail, Zoho, GMX, Fastmail
- **Transactional APIs**: SendGrid, Mailgun, Resend, Amazon SES
- **Local Testing**: MailHog, Mailpit, MailCatcher, Inbucket
- **Webhooks**: Slack, Discord, Telegram

## MCP Tools (42)
send_email, check_inbox, fetch_email_detail, search_emails, delete_email, move_email,
copy_email, forward_email, mark_email_read, mark_email_unread, email_status,
configure_service, remove_service, list_services, email_help, list_folders,
create_folder, delete_folder, rename_folder, mailing_lists_catalog,
mailing_list_latest, suggest_email_subject, email_agentic_assist, start_watcher,
stop_watcher, watcher_status, email_connector, add_contact, search_contacts,
run_workflow, add_auto_rule, list_auto_rules, delete_auto_rule,
list_pending_replies, approve_reply, auto_respond_now

## Architecture
- **Backend**: FastMCP 3.2+ / FastAPI on port 10813
- **Frontend**: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind on port 10812
- **DB**: JSON file-based (contacts, drafts, rules, signatures, templates, scheduled)
- **AI**: Multi-provider (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)
- **Fleet connectors**: aiwatcher (`/api/fleet/ingest`) + robofang (`/api/hooks/email`)

## Key Features
- Microsoft Graph send/receive for personal Outlook/Hotmail (OAuth, auto-refresh)
- Folder treeview with unread counts + inline folder CRUD in the webapp
- Move / copy / forward email operations (tools + REST + webapp)
- AI-assisted compose, improve, expand, and creative workflows (7 presets)
- Auto-respond engine with rule matching, AI drafting, spam detection, spoof mode
- Bulk send with rate limiting and anti-spam safeguards
- Mail Watcher: background IMAP polling with webhook notifications
- Mail Lab: throwaway aiosmtpd SMTP server with AI message generator
- Contact import: CSV, vCard, Google People API, Microsoft Graph API + curated official lists
- Prompt injection defense: Unicode stripping + safety boundary wrapping
- Dual transport: stdio (Claude Desktop) + HTTP streamable

## Environment Variables
- `SMTP_SERVER`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`, `SMTP_FROM` — default SMTP service
- `IMAP_SERVER`, `IMAP_PORT`, `IMAP_USER`, `IMAP_PASSWORD` — default IMAP service
- `EMAIL_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` — Microsoft OAuth client (default: public Graph CLI client ID)
- `EMAIL_MCP_AIWATCHER_URL` — aiwatcher base URL (fleet ingest; unset = disabled)
- `EMAIL_MCP_AIWATCHER_KEY` — X-AIWatcher-Key header when AIWATCHER_API_KEY is set
- `EMAIL_MCP_ROBOFANG_URL` — robofang bridge URL (email hook; unset = disabled)
- `EMAIL_MCP_MAILING_LISTS`, `EMAIL_MCP_MAILING_LISTS_FILE` — newsletter presets
- `EMAIL_SERVICES` — additional services JSON
- `AI_PROVIDER`, `AI_MODEL`, `AI_ENDPOINT`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` — AI features

See [README.md](README.md) for full details.
See [docs/](docs/) for setup guides.
